extracted.intended_audience: military administrators, civil officials, and historians of Napoleonic-era governance
extracted.subtask_description: Transcription and analysis of early-19th-century military and civil correspondence concerning administration, finance, security, and public works in the Illyrian provinces. Useful for historians, archivists, or administrators studying policy directives and on-the-ground practices.

rubrics_metrics.name: Customs tariff — revenue vs. smuggling trade-off
rubrics_metrics.description: 1° D'établir à l'entrée des provinces illyriennes des droits assez forts pour donner le plus de revenu possible et assez faibles pour que la contrebande offre peu d'avantages.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Design duties to maximize revenue while remaining low enough to avoid incentivizing smuggling; particularly important given the large coastline and difficulty of perfect surveillance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Customs tariff — industrial preference ordering
rubrics_metrics.description: 2° Favoriser d'abord l'industrie des provinces illyriennes, ensuite celle de la France, puis celle du royaume d'Italie, et enfin celle du royaume de Naples.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When setting tariff rates and trade policy, give priority protection to local provincial industry, then metropolitan/ally industries in descending order; use tariff policy to shape local industrial development.

rubrics_metrics.name: Customs tariff — transit duties to prevent diversion
rubrics_metrics.description: 3° Établir un droit de transit pour les marchandises qui entrent en Autriche et qui en sortent, dont la consommation ou le départ est présumé être Vienne, et calculer le prix des marchandises de manière à ce que les négociants ne trouvent pas avantage à faire prendre une autre direction à leurs marchandises.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Impose transit duties on goods presumed destined for Vienna and set valuation/pricing so merchants do not reroute trade to avoid duties; calibrate to discourage circuitous routing that undermines intended trade flows.

rubrics_metrics.name: Customs tariff — higher duty on nearby foreign manufactures
rubrics_metrics.description: 4° Augmenter ce droit de transit pour les objets manufacturés en Autriche, en raison du voisinage des provinces illyriennes, et, par conséquent, de la dépendance où elles sont de nos communications.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Charge higher transit duties on Austrian-manufactured goods because of geographical proximity and the provinces' dependence on nearby communications—use this to protect domestic/regional manufactures.

rubrics_metrics.name: Coastal national guard organization and recruitment
rubrics_metrics.description: Establish a coast-guard (garde nationale garde-côtes) from Trieste to Cattaro; admission considered a distinction, attach honorific privileges, provide clothing via company funds, exercise in artillery and small arms, augment with army artillery companies where necessary.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Make guard service socially prestigious to attract wealthy recruits; set up small contributions within companies to outfit the poor; train civilians in cannon/riflework; where local guards are insufficient, attach regular army artillery for key ports.

rubrics_metrics.name: Training and integration of local regiments
rubrics_metrics.description: Translate manoeuvre orders into local language (illyrien), attach French instructors to each regiment, rotate trained local officers/sub-officers into French regiments for instruction, and move to using French commands once unit is proficient.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use language accommodation and embedded French instructors to rapidly bring local units to French drill standards; progressively shift to French commands to enable joint operations with French troops.

rubrics_metrics.name: Anti‑brigandage / counterinsurgency measures
rubrics_metrics.description: Form columns combining chosen officers with detachments of national guards (often men without property), place soldiers in villages suspected of complicity to cut off brigands' supplies and refuge, detain inhabitants until operations conclude, and try captured brigands by permanent military commission.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use combined arms and local auxiliaries less vulnerable to reprisals; isolate brigands by denying local support and provisions; immediate military justice to deter recurrence. The account reports capture and summary execution as effective (sixty+ hanged on the spot).

rubrics_metrics.name: Uniform civil-legal administration (single rule)
rubrics_metrics.description: Une règle unique est indispensable, et alors il y avait autant de lois et de coutumes que de provinces.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Replace the patchwork of provincial laws and customs with a single, uniform legal framework (e.g., await publication of the Civil Code before enforcing certain taxes/registrations) to simplify governance and taxation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Education system establishment and curriculum standards
rubrics_metrics.description: Création de deux écoles centrales (Laybach, Zara), huit lycées, deux écoles d'arts et métiers, écoles primaires dans toutes les communes; instruction supérieure comprenant le latin et le français, les mathématiques et la physique; création de bourses.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Build a tiered public education system (primary through lycée and vocational schools) with a curriculum including classical and scientific subjects; fund scholarships and manage costs economically (noted overall spending outside primary schools).

rubrics_metrics.name: Public works and trade infrastructure policy
rubrics_metrics.description: Création d'un corps des ponts et chaussées composé des meilleurs ingénieurs; construction d'un grand lazaret à Costanitza et d'un entrepôt secondaire à Sissek; établissement d'une administration des postes avec service régulier et communications bihebdomadaires.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Prioritize engineering corps for roads/bridges, health/quarantine infrastructure (lazaret) tailored to trade patterns, and postal services to maintain administration and intelligence across provinces.

rubrics_metrics.name: Military logistics: horse provisioning system
rubrics_metrics.description: Répartir chez les cultivateurs solvables douze cents chevaux d'artillerie et d'équipages, avec obligation de les représenter au moment du besoin, ou d'autres de même valeur.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Implement a system of impressed/committed horses from solvent farmers for rapid mobilization; accept some attrition but retain substantial strategic benefit and cost-effectiveness compared with procuring horses after wars.

rubrics_metrics.name: Fiscal/short-term financing for urgent needs
rubrics_metrics.description: Faced with extreme and urgent needs, an emprunt of cinq cent mille francs à Trieste was made as a temporary resource; creation of revenue enterprises (tabac régie, powder manufacturing, salpêtrières) and delay of certain taxes until legal codification.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use short-term municipal/state borrowing to cover urgent expenditures; create state monopolies or enterprises to generate revenue; postpone hard-to-administer taxes until unified legal frameworks are in place to avoid collection problems.

rubrics_metrics.name: Conditional arming of local troops (security vetting)
rubrics_metrics.description: Sa Majesté trouve la demande bien prématurée... elle autorise, si vous êtes bien assuré que les Croates ne se serviront pas contre nous des armes... à faire armer tout au plus une compagnie par régiment, mais sans excéder le nombre de mille hommes armés.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Restrict large-scale arming of local/regional troops until their political disposition and loyalty are well ascertained; permit limited arming (e.g., one company per regiment; cap total numbers) and source weapons from secure depots.

rubrics_metrics.name: Ensure troop subsistence when changing pay/footing
rubrics_metrics.description: When placing troops on 'pied de paix' (peace footing) and suspending war supplements, the commander warns troops cannot live if paid in depreciated paper at the market rate; requests either payment in specie, provision of food in kind, or a fixed exchange decision.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Before reducing monetary supplements, ensure a practical means for troops to subsist: fix exchange rates for paper currency, provide in-kind provisions, or supply emergency cash funds for units in provinces lacking circulating paper money.

rubrics_metrics.name: Marriage age legal reform
rubrics_metrics.description: Les mariages, trop précoces et autorisés dès l'âge de douze à quinze ans, furent défendus avant seize ans pour les filles et dix-huit ans pour les hommes.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Raise minimum marriage ages to protect population welfare; legislate specific age thresholds (girls 16, boys 18) as part of civil-law modernization.

rubrics_metrics.name: Administrative coordination between military governor and financial/intendant services
rubrics_metrics.description: L'intention de l'Empereur est que Votre Excellence administre ce pays, en touche les revenus, et les fasse servir à l'entretien des troupes... Sa Majesté vous recommande cependant, monsieur le maréchal, de ne rien faire, pour les finances que de concert et par le canal de M. le conseiller d'État d'Auchy.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Coordinate major financial decisions between the military governor and the state's financial/intendance apparatus; avoid unilateral fiscal actions and defer to designated financial channels to prevent administrative conflict and ensure proper accounting.
